ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left of the figure is a five-membered ring containing two oxygen atoms, and the ring has R and R1 generic substituents. On the right side of the ring there is an exocyclic C=S thiocarbonyl fragment, and on the right is :P(OMe)3 marked with a lone pair. Curved arrows show the lone pair of phosphorus pointing to the sulfur atom, while the π-bond electrons of C=S point to the carbonyl carbon on the ring. Reasoning: After pushing the arrows, P and S form a new bond, so sulfur is connected to P(OMe)3; the C=S π-bond electrons transfer to carbon, making the original C=S become a C-S single bond and making that carbon on the ring bear a negative charge. Phosphorus is now connected to S and three methoxy groups, with four substituent bonds in total, so it bears a positive charge. The five-membered ring skeleton and R/R1 generic connections remain unchanged, represented with wildcards, giving the SMILES as *C1O[C-](S[P+](OC)(OC)OC)OC1*.

method.method_draft: Start from the depicted cyclic thione. Apply the P-to-S arrow to create an S-P(OMe)3 bond. Apply the C=S pi-bond arrow toward carbon to convert C=S into C-S and put a negative charge on the ring carbon. Assign phosphorus a positive charge because it now has four substituent bonds: S plus three methoxy groups. Keep the five-membered ring and R/R1 generic attachments unchanged, then encode the product as *C1O[C-](S[P+](OC)(OC)OC)OC1*.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个含两个氧原子的五元环，环上有 R 和 R1 泛基取代。环右侧有一个外侧 C=S 硫羰基片段，右边是带孤对电子标记的 :P(OMe)3。弯箭头显示磷的孤对电子指向硫原子，同时 C=S 的 π 键电子箭头指向环上的羰基碳。推理：按箭头推动后，P 与 S 形成新键，因此硫连接到 P(OMe)3；C=S π 键电子转移到碳，使原 C=S 变为 C-S 单键，并使环上该碳带负电荷。磷现在连接 S 和三个甲氧基，共四个取代键，因此带正电荷。五元环骨架和 R/R1 泛基连接保持不变，用通配符表示，得到 SMILES 为 *C1O[C-](S[P+](OC)(OC)OC)OC1*。

method.method_draft: Recognize the substrate as a cyclic thione with a thiocarbonyl carbon embedded between two oxygens of the ring. Form the addition product by attaching P(OMe)3 to sulfur while reducing the C=S double bond to a single C-S bond. Use charge conservation and normal valences to place positive charge on tetravalent phosphorus and negative charge on the former thiocarbonyl carbon; leave R and R1 represented by wildcard ends. Write the resulting cyclic SMILES with the anionic carbon bearing S[P+](OC)(OC)OC: *C1O[C-](S[P+](OC)(OC)OC)OC1*.
